games.headline: Antetokounmpo has 22 points and 23 rebounds as the Heat stop the Knicks' 6-game winning streak
games.desc: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, Bam Adebayo scored 25 points and the Miami Heat ended the New York Knicks' six-game winning streak and NBA Cup title reign with a 108-105 victory Friday night.

games.headline: Isaiah Joe scores 22 points, Pistons' reserves power NBA Cup win over Bucks
games.desc: — Isaiah Joe scored 22 points to help the Detroit Pistons overcome a slow start and beat the Milwaukee Bucks 113-98 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: LeBron James and 76ers breeze past Pacers 111-87, advance to NBA Cup knockout round
games.desc: — LeBron James had 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists, and the Philadelphia 76ers breezed past the Indiana Pacers 111-87 on Friday night to win East Group B and advance to the knockout round of the

games.headline: Raptors beat Nets in final NBA Cup group-stage game for both teams
games.desc: — Scottie Barnes scored 34 points and the Toronto Raptors beat the Brooklyn Nets 124-100 on Friday night in the final NBA Cup group-stage game for both teams.

games.headline: Johnson helps Hawks close out NBA Cup group stage with 87-86 win over Celtics
games.desc: — Jalen Johnson had 24 points, Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored Atlanta’s final four points as part of a 20-point night and the Hawks beat the Boston Celtics 87-86 on Friday in the final NBA Cup group-stage game for both teams.

games.headline: Grizzlies top Timberwolves 114-109 to win NBA Cup West Group B
games.desc: — Cedric Coward scored 22 points, Javon Small tied a season high with 19 points off the bench, and the Memphis Grizzlies won the NBA Cup West Group B on Friday with a 114-109 win over the Minnesota Timberwolves.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg leads Mavericks' rally to beat Suns, finish 4-0 in NBA Cup group play
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg scored 34 points and led a late Dallas charge in a 113-109 victory over the Phoenix Suns that left the Mavericks perfect in NBA Cup group play.

games.headline: Spurs ride second-half surge to earn spot in NBA Cup knockout round with 99-96 victory over Lakers
games.desc: — Stephon Castle had 26 points, Victor Wembanyama had 25 points and 16 rebounds, and the San Antonio Spurs surged in the second half for a 99-96 win over the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday night to advance to the NBA Cup knockout round.

games.headline: Jamal Murray scores 36 to lead Nuggets past Jazz 120-107
games.desc: — Jamal Murray scored 36 points to rally the Denver Nuggets to a 120-107 victory over the Utah Jazz in NBA Cup group play on Friday night.

games.headline: Pelicans beat Clippers 105-104 in NBA Cup group finale
games.desc: — Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III each scored 25 points and the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Los Angeles Clippers 105-104 on Friday night in their NBA Cup group finale.

games.headline: Trail Blazers beat the Warriors 116-94 to advance to the NBA Cup quarterfinals
games.desc: — Deni Avdija had 26 points and eight rebounds, Toumani Camara added 20 points and eight rebounds and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Golden State Warriors 116-94 on Friday night to advance to the NBA Cup quarterfinals.
